channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio avança entre católicos, mas ainda busca apoio de apóstolos digitais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) gains ground among evangelicals with support from the Assembleia de Deus de Madureira, which has 30 million faithful, strengthening his candidacy in the second round.

item.title: Tarcísio compartilha imagem feita fora do Brasil para criticar ato pró-Lula
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas shared an image made outside Brazil to criticize a pro-Lula rally in SP, linking it to drug and vandalism footage. The recording was already circulating before the protest, with no confirmation it was made in Brazil.

item.title: Festival de filmes feitos com inteligência artificial estreia no Brasil em novembro
item.description: Brazil will host the first edition of the AI Film Awards in November, an international festival exclusively dedicated to films produced entirely with artificial intelligence. The event, held at Itaú Cultural in São Paulo, received 227 submissions from 22 countries, more than double the initially expected amount.

item.title: Tarcísio critica vandalismo em ato pró-Lula na Paulista
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized acts of vandalism during a pro-Lula event on Paulista Avenue, comparing the protest to actions by Jair Bolsonaro supporters. He emphasized the need for proper conduct in public demonstrations.

item.title: Ato pró-Lula ocupa av. Atlântica em Copacabana, no Rio
item.description: Lula's supporters occupied the Copacabana oceanfront avenue in Rio de Janeiro as part of the PT campaign for the second round against Flávio Bolsonaro. The mobilization occurred on the holiday of Our Lady of Aparecida, gathering students, union members, and left-wing politicians.

item.title: Propaganda eleitoral de Flávio na TV é transmitida sem som
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign ad was broadcast without sound on some TV stations during free airtime, as claimed by the candidate himself on social media. The Superior Electoral Court has not yet commented on the incident, whose causes remain unclear. Users also reported similar sound issues in Lula's (PT) broadcast, which was reportedly partially fixed.

item.title: Caça às bruxas aos isentões? Público cobra posicionamento político de celebridades
item.description: Internet users have been demanding political stances from celebrities such as Jade Picon, Maju Trindade, Selton Mello, and Vini Jr., using memes and spreadsheets to pressure public figures to endorse a candidate. This movement, amplified by accounts like Brics_Brasil, also takes on a regional tone by questioning the silence of Northeastern artists, particularly in a region where the PT leads voter intentions.

item.title: Flávio pretende visitar Bolsonaro nesta terça-feira e diz estar ansioso por reencontro
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro plans to visit his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, after over three months without meetings, following authorization by STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Flávio expressed eagerness to reunite with his father, who is under house arrest for conviction in the coup plot, and criticized the lengthy suspension of visits during the electoral race.

item.title: Veja ato de Lula na av. Paulista em imagens captadas do alto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attended a pro-campaign rally on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, with images captured by a drone from the Metropolitan Guard. The event took place between 12:31 PM and 1:03 PM, with the presence of authorities such as Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and re-elected governors. The crowd estimate ranges from 261,000 to 1 million people, depending on the assumed density.

item.title: “Claro atropelo”, diz campanha de Flávio sobre decisões do TSE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized alleged favorable decisions toward Lula, accusing the TSE of applying double standards when handling fake news. The PL-RJ presidential candidate labeled the TSE's actions as a 'clear overreach' and demanded stricter oversight of misleading content online.

item.title: Lula defende respeito às religiões no Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: President Lula advocated for respect toward religions on the Day of Our Lady of Aparecida, denouncing offenses and emphasizing harmony and democracy. He also underscored social programs such as Minha Casa, Minha Vida and commitments to inclusive housing.

item.title: Paes ainda pode ajudar Lula a vencer no Rio?
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro mayor Eduardo Paes (PSD) stated he still plans to support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 presidential election, despite losing to Douglas Ruas (PL) in the state gubernatorial race. Ruas’s victory strengthens the PL as the dominant political force in Rio, potentially influencing the national electoral landscape.

item.title: PL deve liberar bancada em votação da proposta que acaba com a escala 6 por 1 no Senado, diz líder do bloco da oposição
item.description: The PL is expected to allow its bench to vote on the PEC ending the 6-day work cycle in the Senate, despite the Flávio Bolsonaro campaign's preference for abstention. The government opposition in the Senate, including parties like the PP, will likely support opening the vote, as the Lula administration seeks to pass the proposal before the 2026 elections.

item.title: Manifestantes fazem ato pró-Lula em Copacabana, no Rio
item.description: Supporters held a pro-Lula rally in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, featuring caravans, flag-waving, and walks along the waterfront. The gathering, organized by social movements and entities, emphasized defending democracy and mobilizing voters who stayed away from the first round.

item.title: Haddad diz que caso Master é 'grande oportunidade de passar o país a limpo, incluindo o Judiciário'
item.description: Haddad sees the Master case as an opportunity to uncover irregularities in Brazil, including within the judiciary, and supports liquidating the bank. He warns the runoff will be tight and argues the administration must balance showcasing achievements with forward-looking proposals addressing voter concerns like jobs and climate change.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio acusa fraude após programa eleitoral ir ao ar sem som
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) accused Lula's campaign of interfering with the electoral system after his campaign ad was broadcast without sound on TV, while Lula's ad aired normally. Flávio's campaign claimed the sound issue was intentional to silence him.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula usa Dia das Crianças para fazer propaganda do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula leveraged Children's Day to promote the abolition of the 6×1 work schedule, sharing a video narrative emphasizing the value of paternal time. The initiative seeks to spark debates on labor rights and work-life balance.

item.title: Duas novas pesquisas de voto da disputa presidencial no 2° turno saem nos próximos dias; veja datas
item.description: Two polls for the 2026 second-round vote will be released this week: Quaest (Oct 14) and Datafolha (Oct 15). Both measure the race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with a ±2 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence.

item.title: O que a área técnica do TSE disse sobre o canal ‘Exército do Lula’, questionado pela campanha de Flávio
item.description: The technical team of the TSE concluded that the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel did not share the false news pointed out by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, despite the temporary suspension ordered by the TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques. The decision was reversed by the chief clerk of the Electoral Justice, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, who emphasized the restriction on freedom of expression.

item.title: “Ansioso para dar um abraço em Bolsonaro”, diz Flávio após decisão de Moraes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, stated he will visit his father Jair Bolsonaro after Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision allowing prisoner meetings at home detention again. The meeting will take place Tuesday morning after over three months of restrictions.

item.title: TV CELULAR | O BRASIL VAI VENCER 11/10/2026
item.description: The video features a political ad titled 'TV CELULAR | O BRASIL VAI VENCER', dated October 11, 2026, suggesting a future election campaign. The content is a standard YouTube video link with basic playback elements, without explicitly naming any specific candidates.

item.title: Lula quer aumentar incentivos à cultura; Flávio defende patrimônio
item.description: Lula proposes to expand cultural incentives with investments and state policies, while Flávio defends the preservation of historical heritage. PT governments prioritized the cultural area, as the Bolsonaro government reduced funding and extinguished the Ministry of Culture.

item.title: Ao citar endividamento, Messias diz que Bolsonaro não cuidou das famílias
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias criticized the Bolsonaro administration for failing to adequately support families during the pandemic, linking the rise in household debt to the health crisis and prior management. He endorsed the Desenrola 3.0 debt renegotiation program announced by Lula and called for votes in the second round.

item.title: Funcionários limpam estação de metrô pichada em ato pró-Lula na Paulista
item.description: During a pro-Lula rally on Paulista Avenue, protesters vandalized the entrance to Trianon-Masp station, damaging glass and walls. City Hall and Metro workers cleaned up the graffiti and damage on Monday, October 12. Opposition leaders criticized the incidents, linking them to the left and support for Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Rio tem ato de apoiadores de Lula em Copacabana durante feriado nacional
item.description: Supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held a rally in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, on Monday, December 12, 2026, defending his candidacy. The event took place on a national holiday, mobilizing sectors supporting the re-election of the PT leader for the 2026 elections.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Ipespe sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula na reta final do segundo turno
item.description: On October 17, Ipespe will release a new national poll on the race between Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, measuring vote intentions, campaign performance, rejection, trust, key issues and turnout likelihood. The survey of 1,500 phone interviews (Oct 13-15) also assesses perceptions of each candidate’s media presence and the probability of voting in the runoff.

item.title: Carta assinada por Wagner Moura e artistas manifesta preocupação com eleições no Brasil
item.description: Brazilian artists, including Wagner Moura and Kleber Mendonça Filho, released an open letter expressing concerns about the 2026 runoff election, calling for investigations into alleged foreign interference and voter payments. The manifesto questions proposals by Flávio Bolsonaro, such as a new constitution and amnesty for his father, highlighting risks to democracy and Brazilian culture.

item.title: Decisão de Nunes Marques sobre canal pró-Lula contraria busca por pacificação, dizem especialistas
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the takedown of 'Exército de Lula' channel, viewed as heterodox and contrary to the electoral pacification promoted by minister Edson Fachin. The decision via administrative route sparked controversy over judicial parallelism and electoral impact.

item.title: Flávio comemora decisão de Moraes e diz que vai visitar Jair Bolsonaro nesta terça-feira
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes's decision allowing him to resume visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest. Flávio emphasized the visit will be personal, rejecting claims of political intent and underscoring the significance of reuniting with his father during the election period.

item.title: Brasil está prestes a passar os EUA como maior superpotência agrícola
item.description: Brazil may overtake the US as the world's leading agricultural superpower, according to a Financial Times projection highlighting agricultural performance under Lula's government. Leadership in global agriculture represents a significant milestone for the Brazilian economy. This position reflects the crucial role of agriculture in diplomacy and food production.

item.title: O que Lula e Flávio devem fazer para vencer a eleição? Analistas respondem
item.description: Lula and Flávio are closely matched in votes, with the smallest margin since the return to democracy, and will face off in the second round on the 25th. Each candidate employs different campaign strategies to win over new voters, focusing on issues such as economy, security, and healthcare.

item.title: Pesquisa presidente: semana terá rodada com Quaest, BTG/Nexus e Datafolha
item.description: The runoff race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) will see at least four new national polls released this week, including surveys from BTG/Nexus, Quaest, Datafolha, and Palver.

item.title: Saiba como estão Lula e Flávio nas pesquisas a 13 dias do 2º turno
item.description: The latest national polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in 5 out of 6 surveys for the 2nd round, with narrow margins between the candidates. Only the Vox Brasil survey shows Lula ahead numerically, within the margin of error. The runoff takes place on October 25th.

item.title: Lula teve maior votação percentual no PI; Flávio, em RR
item.description: In the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) achieved his best percentage performance in Piauí (70.99%) and his worst in Roraima (22.86%), while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) had his best result in Roraima (71.06%) and his worst in Piauí (24.09%). Flávio outperformed his father Jair Bolsonaro in every state in 2022, except the Federal District. Lula will face Flávio in the second round on October 25, 2026, after PL won 14 states plus Brasília in the first round.

item.title: Aparecida espera receber 500 mil fiéis no feriado da padroeira
item.description: The city of Aparecida (SP) expects over 500,000 faithful during the Our Lady of Aparecida festival in October 2026, with an estimated economic impact of R$ 3.59 billion. Archbishop Dom Mário Antônio emphasized the celebration should focus on faith, not electoral disputes, following fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Dia das Crianças: 6.253 menores de idade esperam adoção
item.description: On Children's Day 2026, Brazil has 6,253 minors waiting for adoption, while 31,434 people wish to adopt, resulting in five applicants for every available child. Bureaucracy and the preference for young girls without disabilities hinder the adoption of teenagers and children with special needs, as shown by the case of former officer Carlos Hogendorp, who was adopted at age five and now volunteers in shelters. Specialists emphasize the need to shift preference patterns to reduce the lengthy waiting list.

item.title: Aldeia indígena que 'estreou' nestas eleições deu a Lula seu melhor resultado no RJ
item.description: For the first time in history, the Sapukai Indigenous Village in Angra dos Reis (RJ) held an electoral section and gave Lula his highest vote percentage in the state, with 96% (147 out of 153 voters). In second place, the voting section at the Federal University of Engineering in Niterói also favored Lula with 81% of nominal votes. These outcomes highlight the significant influence of the indigenous community in the local electorate.

item.title: Raquel Lyra: ‘Não vale tudo na política, e papéis das instituições estão confusos’
item.description: Raquel Lyra, reelected governor of Pernambuco, emphasized the need to unite the population and criticized political polarization and the lack of clarity regarding institutional roles. She stated that not declaring a vote aims to maintain neutrality and place the state's interests above partisan disputes.

item.title: Recorde de governadores eleitos no 1º turno amplia desafio de Lula e Flávio contra abstenção
item.description: With 21 governors elected in the first round, Lula and Flávio face higher abstention in the second round. The smallest candidate margin (1.87 points) requires mobilization in decided states.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: planos para o esporte opõem incentivo público e financiamento privado
item.description: Lula and Flávio present opposing sports policies: Lula advocates for increased public funding, including the University of Sports and expanded athlete scholarships, while Flávio pushes for private investment and proposes banning transgender women from women's competitions.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula propõem sobre o funcionalismo público
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes a 'scissor' policy to reduce the public service as part of fiscal adjustment, raising concerns about public competitions and civil servants. Lula criticizes the proposal, advocating for the appreciation of servers. Bolsonaro's campaign denied intending to end public competitions.

item.title: Para ala do PL, aposentadoria de ministros do STF é melhor que impeachment
item.description: A faction of the PL party proposes the early retirement of STF ministers like Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino as a 'more peaceful' alternative to impeachment. With the largest Senate caucus in 2027, the party aims to consolidate influence in the judiciary. The strategy avoids direct confrontation, inspired by Barroso's 2025 departure.

item.title: Voto de Lula para deputado federal não foi para Edinho Silva, presidente do PT e coordenador de sua campanha à presidência
item.description: Lula did not vote for Edinho Silva, PT president and campaign coordinator. The former president's ballot did not record votes for Edinho, who was elected federal deputy for São Paulo.

item.title: Além do Planalto: como a eleição para o Congresso pode afetar impostos, empresas e dinheiro público
item.description: The 2026 election for the Brazilian National Congress can directly impact the country's economy, particularly regarding tax reform, inheritance taxes, and the allocation of parliamentary amendments in 2027. The elected deputies and senators, who take office in February 2027, will play a key role in implementing and adjusting the new fiscal legislation. The Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) campaign has already expressed intentions to modify mechanisms such as the 'split payment,' which automatically separates taxes in business transactions.

item.title: Eleições: Niterói se mantém à esquerda, mas vê PL crescer
item.description: Niterói maintained preference for left-wing candidates in the municipal elections, with 125,231 votes for progressive contenders, but the PL led individually with Douglas Gomes elected as federal deputy. The reelection of Lula and Eduardo Paes reinforced the trend of progressive votes in the city.

item.title: Nossa Senhora Aparecida: por que a santa envolvida em polêmica eleitoral é a padroeira do Brasil?
item.description: The law that canonized Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint on October 12th sparked debates about church-state separation in a secular country. In 2026, the saint's involvement in electoral controversies rekindled questions about religion's role in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Como Nossa Senhora Aparecida foi proclamada rainha e padroeira do Brasil
item.description: The image of Our Lady of Aparecida was found by fishermen in the Paraíba do Sul River on October 12, 1717, after a miraculous catch. She was proclaimed patroness of Brazil in 1930 and has been a symbol of faith, though recently involved in political misinformation. The saint remains central to the country's Catholic identity.

item.title: Memes sobre Lula e Flávio viralizam nas redes sociais logo após o 1º turno
item.description: Memes about Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) went viral on social media after the first round of the 2026 elections on October 4. The runoff is scheduled for October 25, with polls showing a tight race. AI-generated videos highlight the humor and polarization of the election.

item.title: Orçamento, 6x1 e mais: não eleitos ajudam a traçar o rumo de temas centrais
item.description: Non-reelected lawmakers will keep voting until January 2027, shaping the 2027 budget and the 6x1 work schedule PEC, whose impacts extend beyond their terms.

item.title: Autora do impeachment de Dilma lamenta derrota: “Por que não recebi voto?”
item.description: Janaína Paschoal, author of Dilma Rousseff's impeachment, lamented her defeat in the election for the Chamber of Deputies, receiving fewer votes than in the previous election for councilwoman. She questioned whether her loss was due to merit or communication failure, highlighting her parliamentary work and project studies.
